text:
Ali: Heads-up — hitting slab freeze on MetricPanel in EU canary after today's frontend rollout (deploy 2026-03-19_12:04). Charts hang for ~3-6s intermittently when opening dashboards with ~200 rows.
Sam: Can you paste the console timeline? any long tasks?
Ali: Timeline snippet: Main thread long tasks 3200ms at index-render; flame shows repeated parse/execute of chunk 'viz-tiles.js' and a bunch of HTTP/200 for /assets/metric-row-xx.js
Ali: Deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-19T12:04:12Z -> canary eu (id: dpl-eu-7902) :rocket:
Maria: From telemetry: sample_id=ae3f latency spikes correlate with bundle size jump + KV cache misses. Percentiles: p50=120ms, p95=2.7s, p99=4.9s for initial chart paint.
Sam: I tried a local repro — turning off prefetch (client.prefetch=false) reduces p95 to ~650ms. Suspect prefetching is causing thrash plus kvcache eviction on small nodes.
Jun: Possible root: splitpoint rollup changed dynamic import path. We now inline less of the viz runtime, pushing more small chunk requests that block eval. Maybe chunk count > 40 for large dashboards.
Ali: Quick grep of canary bundle mapping:
```
dynamicImports: [
 "viz-tiles.js",
 "metric-row-accordion.js",
 "viz-heatline.js",
 "legacy-tooltip.js",
 ...
]
```
Ali: Also seeing 3xx redirects for CDN region selection — extra roundtrip ~120ms per chunk in eu canary.
Sam: Proposal: 1) revert the prefetch change for canary customers; 2) temporary bundle coalescing: build flag to merge viz runtime into main for canary; 3) increase kvcache TTL for metric-panel keys in EU.
Maria: + add telemetry label for "prefetch:true|false" and rollout tag so we can A/B properly.
Ali: Anyone object? We should patch canary quickly, keep prod untouched.
Jun: No objections. I'll open a PR to add a canary-only build switch + kvcache TTL tweak. Assign to @jun and @sam.
Sam: I'll prepare a small e2e with 200-rows dashboard load and post updated telemetry.
Ali: Thanks. Tagging eng-sre for CDN redirects — @Oliver can you validate the region selection rule? (cc @deploy-bot)
deploy-bot: Deploy dpl-eu-7902 noted. Rollback candidate dpl-eu-7888 available.
Oliver: Looking — region selection rule new rule rolled yesterday. Quick fix: set edge-pop affinity for /assets/*.js to origin-eu to avoid redirect; rolling patch in 10m.
Ali: Will monitor. If p95 doesn't fall within 30m we rollback canary.
Sam: I'll update the canary dashboard widget to include 'prefetch' label so we can see split.
Maria: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
